name: room_air_conditioning_coil_reheat
title: Air conditioning of a room: cooling-dehumidifying coil and reheat
summary: An AHU conditions 40 m3/h of outdoor air (30 C, 60 % RH) for a room held at 25 C and 50 % saturation (1 bar) with one occupant releasing 130 W and 80 g/h of water. The room balances give the supply state; the cooling coil dehumidifies to a saturated state at the supply humidity ratio (condensate enthalpy in the first law) and the reheat coil restores the supply temperature.

verification.summary: Compared with the solution stored in the source EES file THD10_R10_E3.EES (35 variables, full stored solution) via tools/compare_solution.py --ees-units on the _coolsolve variant: 35 common variables, 19 differ (rtol=0.001), maximum relative deviation 5.37e-03 (humidity ratios), the known EES-vs-CoolProp humid-air difference as on CSL-0028/CSL-0016.
verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file THD10_R10_E3.EES (EES 8.423)
verification.notes: The native file is blocked (CS-GAP-PSYCHRO-SAT); the comparison concerns the _coolsolve variant (dewpoint form of the same saturated state). The condensate mass flow q_m_cond is not in the EES reference; it is verified through q_v_cond (4.13e-03). Cross-model: CSL-0028, the 2005 version of the same exercise, agrees on the shared outputs to within the property difference.
